newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates fall as liquidity demand eases.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates fall as liquidity demand eases.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates fell at midday on Tuesday as cash demand eased after the five-day Chinese lunar new year holiday, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 6.293 percent against Wednesday's 6.718 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.75-6.00 against 6.00-6.25.
Dealers expected the money rates to test their lower levels in the near term as liquidity would gradually return to the banking system.
The government bond yields were down, with the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.048-6.049 and the 15-year construction bond yield at 6.225.
